exposure: Previable rupture of membranes (gestational age < 23 weeks, latency period >= 2 weeks)
cohort: Neonates born after previable rupture of membranes (gestational age < 23 weeks, latency period >= 2 weeks)
finding: Infants born after previable rupture of membranes have high rates of mortality and disability, but those treated for refractory hypoxic respiratory failure may have similar long-term outcomes to those without respiratory failure.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased survival
